name: Media Organizer 1.4.0
body:
**Commercial-completeness release:**
- Total library size shown: "12,427 files · 48.2 GB total · 47.9 GB to copy"
- Sortable columns — click any header (size sorts numerically, dates chronologically)
- Resizable columns + remembered layout (widths, sort, window size all persist)
- Right-click any file: exclude from plan / include / open file location (double-click also opens)
- Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+O, Enter, Esc), busy cursor, empty-state hints

151 automated tests, all passing.

Download **MediaOrganizer-Setup-1.4.0.exe** below.
